fusions.name: Spore Shake
fusions.desc: Shakes a cloud of spores loose, dealing 10 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and leaving them [Diseased] for 8 seconds. Your afflictions on each enemy hit spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles of it.

fusions.name: Creeping Bloom
fusions.desc: Spits a clump of spores that deals 4 damage and makes the target [Diseased] for 1 damage a second for 5 seconds. Its damage rises 8% for each affliction already on the target (max 40%).

fusions.name: Slick Plumage
fusions.desc: For 4 seconds, each condition laid on you has a 50% chance to be sent back to whoever laid it.

fusions.name: Quiet Growth
fusions.desc: Your maximum health rises by 12. You also regenerate 0.5 health a second, permanently.
